basic_profile.bio: Avid manga reader and collector based in the Netherlands. I love exploring different genres of manga and light novels, especially fantasy and mystery. I'm currently a student studying graphic design and often find myself inspired by the art styles in manga. I'm usually online in the evenings, after classes, and on weekends. I'm single and enjoy spending my free time reading and engaging with online communities about my interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: As a graphic design student, I've developed a keen eye for illustrations and storytelling. My interest in manga began during my high school years, where I started learning Japanese to better understand the original content. I often share insights on manga artistry and narrative techniques.
